manual_findings.photos: All three methods remove noise but miss the fine canopy cords; cloud texture and facade/window detail remain softened. RAM does not show a clear photographic detail improvement.
manual_findings.GFX_sky: RAM leaves fine diagonal/periodic-looking texture and small residual marks in the nominally flat sky, while V43/V63 are smoother. Independent ISO100 has grain and is not exact GT.
manual_findings.GFX_building: RAM retains visibly more grain/color texture in the facade; the shared strong posts/truss remain.
manual_findings.GFX_foliage: RAM has a more textured, greener leaf appearance, with residual grain; the independent f5.6 reference is sharper and cannot establish pixelwise recovery.
manual_findings.GFX_fence: The chain-link pattern is continuous in all three methods; RAM looks more textured, without a demonstrated broad quality improvement.

scope: Fixed two native256 photo observations/central160 exact synthetic GT, plus four native512 standing GFX contexts/central160 views with independent ISO100 AHD reference (not GT). Original zero-shot RAM CPU/B1/FP32 with exact provided mosaic and shot/read sigma. Repeated arrays/state/input/RNG checks, fresh RAM predictions and retained actual IEEE-CUDA V43/V63 arrays from identical observations. No noise regeneration, target input/output fitting, adaptation on captures, DINO replacement, production dependency/default change, full-suite/full-frame/speed/SOTA or broad quality claim. Original code BSD-3-Clause; separate weight terms unverified.
